newsitem.title: JAPAN: All TOCOM palladium futures tumble by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: All TOCOM palladium futures tumble by daily limit.

text.p: All yen-based palladium futures tumbled by their 24 yen per gram daily limit at the opening of Tokyo trade on Monday, following sharp losses in New York on Friday due to Russia's expected resumption of platinum group metal (PGM) exports, traders said.
"Following sharp falls in spot palladium prices on Friday, the feeeling that palladium prices have reached a ceiling, prompted some fresh selling here," an analyst at a commodity brokerage said.
"Palladium prices are likely to be stuck at their limit lows for most of the day," he said.
